Solutions for the end-of-chapter exercises in *Chapter 7: Sampling*. Primary dataset: `volcanoes` from [`volcanoes`](https://github.com/moderndive/volcanoes); secondary: `eruptions` (same package) and `planets` from [`exoplanets`](https://github.com/moderndive/exoplanets).

```{r}
#| label: ch7-coverage
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| message: false
helpers <- Find(file.exists, c("scripts/exercise_helpers.R", "../scripts/exercise_helpers.R", "../../scripts/exercise_helpers.R"))
source(helpers)
cat(render_coverage_callout(7))
```

```{r}
#| label: 07-ex-setup
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(moderndive)
library(infer)
library(volcanoes)

mu     <- mean(volcanoes$elevation, na.rm = TRUE)
sigma  <- sd(volcanoes$elevation, na.rm = TRUE)
p_strato <- mean(volcanoes$primary_volcano_type == "Stratovolcano",
                 na.rm = TRUE)
```
